svg.title: Improving the answers: a loop between the business and the admin
svg.desc: The admin exports the business facts, the saved answers, the channel's own answers and some masked chats. The business feeds them to an AI of its own choice, has it play customers, and writes down the fixes in plain words. The admin puts the fixes into the files and the reply rules, tries them on a test channel, then on the live one, and the loop starts again. Day to day, a good reply written by a person can be saved from the dashboard, and learning suggestions are accepted or rejected there.
svg.text: THE BUSINESS (owner, management)
THE ADMIN (runs the server)
1. Export
business facts, saved answers, channel
answers, and recent chats with names
and numbers masked
2. Simulate with your own AI
feed it the files, tell it to answer
only from them, and play customers:
the questions you get, and the odd ones
see where an answer is wrong or missing
3. Write the fixes, in plain words
a missing fact, a new answer, words
customers really use, a price that
changed, a tone that is off, what must
always go to a person
4. Put them into the files
facts and answers; reply rules where
needed: pace, hours, links, when to
stop and hand over, web search, learning
plain text files, no restart
5. Try, then go live
a test channel with fast rules first,
then the live channel with cautious ones
the chats there are the next export
Every day, on the dashboard
a good reply by a person: press "save",
and it becomes a channel answer
AI learning suggestions: accept or reject
each, none reaches a customer unseen
an AI draft goes into the reply box, sent
only by a person
The four files the business can read, and what each is for
Business facts (text)
who the business is, what it offers, hours,
places, the only prices that may be given,
and the rules the AI must keep; the AI may
say nothing that is not written here
Saved answers (list)
approved replies, each with its keywords and
its text in every language the business uses;
sent by plain code, no AI; may mark one to alert
a person, or to always keep its links
Channel answers (list)
one channel's own additions, saved from the
dashboard; same form as the saved answers,
they win over them on that channel; the place
to try an answer before it goes to every channel
Reply rules (settings)
how and when, not what: delays, hours, the pause
after a person replies, links, when to stop and
hand over, web search limits, learning on or off;
a fast set for testing, a cautious set for live
The hub's own code (admin only):
where the tokens are saved
the keyword matcher: most messages are
answered with no AI at all
the gate: no AI call when a person just
replied, paused, night, answer just sent
what the AI sees: one line per saved
answer, and the last turns only
its dials, in the reply rules: past turns,
daily caps, answer size, AI replies per
hour, web searches per day
better files mean fewer AI calls
the admin
an AI of the business's choice
people at the business
